I can see the Settings app is now open. I need to navigate to the "Network & internet" section to access Wi-Fi settings. I can see the "Network & internet" option with the description "Mobile, Wi‑Fi, hotspot" which is exactly what I need. I should tap on this option.

Looking at the coordinates, the "Network & internet" option appears to be at around [0,328,999,428].
